event_chain.summary: Insomnia posts claim to leak site (extortion)

summary: Nephrology Associates Medical Group discovered suspicious activity in an employee's email account on or about May 20, 2025, and engaged cybersecurity experts to investigate. The investigation determined that an unauthorized individual accessed the account, which contained some individuals' personal information. The organization completed notification of affected individuals on December 12, 2025, and reported no evidence of fraudulent misuse. The organization offered two years of complimentary credit monitoring and identity protection services through Kroll to affected individuals. Additional sources on the issue (ClaimDepot, ClassAction.org) report that unauthorized actors accessed the network of Nephrology Associates between January 17 and April 9, 2026, and exfiltrated patient data; the Insomnia ransomware group posted a claim on its Tor leak site on April 5, 2026, stating it had obtained Nephrology Associates data. The investigation concluded July 1, 2026 that names, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, driver's license/state ID numbers, government ID numbers, treatment/diagnosis information, and health insurance policy details were acquired; notifications began July 30, 2026. No ransom or extortion amount was disclosed.
